verdict.rationale: Jumping between prompts is a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no shell-integration prompt or command marks (e.g., OSC 133) and no jump-to-prompt action. Vi-mode scrollback movement, scrollback text search, and SearchStart/SearchEnd match jumps are adjacent navigation features, not prompt-mark navigation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump between prompts and command marks in my scrollback thanks to shell integration
